narrative.overview: Synergy Academy is a calm, structured adult-learning workspace. The visual world is polished and direct rather than decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Blue reserved for navigation, focus, and primary action
Compact operational typography with clear hierarchy
Soft ambient depth and consistently rounded surfaces
Responsive navigation that preserves the same information architecture

rules.name: The Blue Means Action Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies something interactive, selected, or in focus; it does not wash entire content areas without purpose.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Montserrat carries identity and hierarchy; Open Sans carries instructions, data, and extended reading.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Use background contrast before adding elevation; a surface does not need both a prominent border and a prominent shadow.

dos: Do use the supplied full logo assets wherever a full brand signature is appropriate.
Do keep one obvious primary action per form or operational panel.
Do provide loading, empty, error, disabled, hover, and keyboard-focus states.
Do use tabular numerals for changing counts, grades, and percentages.
donts: Don't introduce unrelated gradients, glass effects, hard-offset shadows, or decorative texture.
Don't replace Lucide icons with emoji or platform glyphs.
Don't use warm gold as a general call-to-action color.
Don't expose academic data in decorative or public-facing components.
